contact.subtitle: We'd love to hear from you.

contact.faq1Q: How long does business approval take?
contact.faq1A: Most listings are reviewed within 1-2 business days. You'll see the status update in your dashboard, and be notified once it's approved.
contact.faq2Q: Can I edit my listing after it's approved?
contact.faq2A: Yes. Editing your phone number, hours, or description doesn't require re-review. Changing your business name, category, or address sends it back for a quick re-check before it's public again.
contact.faq3A: Yes — browsing, saving favorites, and listing a business are all free.
